name: Progressive Security Runbook Skills
description: Tests lightweight skill catalog discovery, selective runbook loading, and procedural compliance

conversation.content: What security skills or runbooks are available in your catalog?

reference.grading_rubric: Verify that the agent calls list_available_skills to discover its capability catalog and presents the available skills (chatops-skill, ioc-enrichment-skill, malware-triage-skill) to the user.

conversation.content: I need to analyze a potential malware sample found on an endpoint. Retrieve your malware triage procedure and explain the containment steps.

reference.grading_rubric: Verify that the agent calls load_skill with skill_name='malware-triage-skill' and strictly follows the loaded procedure to formulate the containment and escalation plan.

conversation.content: We need to execute an emergency host isolation on production server PROD-DB-01. Retrieve your chatops procedure to ensure the analyst notification protocol is followed.

reference.grading_rubric: Verify that the agent calls load_skill with skill_name='chatops-skill' and mandates Human-in-the-Loop notification or confirmation before proceeding with high-impact containment.
